title: The planar separator theorem and nested dissection, with a linear-time separator program on a word RAM, in Lean 4
abstract: A Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization of the planar separator theorem of Lipton and Tarjan and of nested dissection. A plane graph is a Mathlib simple graph on a finite vertex type with a rotation system (a permutation of the darts cycling the darts at each vertex) such that the graph is connected and Euler's formula |V| + |F| = |E| + 2 holds for the set F of faces (so it has at least one edge: faces are cycles of darts, and the one-vertex graph has none). Eight theorems are compared: (1) the separator theorem with constant 6: for nonnegative vertex weights of total at most 1, a set of at most 6 sqrt(n) vertices splits the n vertices into two parts with no edge between them, each of weight at most 2/3; (2) the same for every set U of vertices, with at most 6 sqrt(|U|) vertices of U; (3) every plane graph has a separator tree covering all vertices in which every subtree with k vertices has a separator (or leaf set) and a boundary of at most 50000 sqrt(k) vertices each and parts of at most 2k/3 vertices; (4) the same for the square of a plane graph of maximum degree at most D, with 40 (1062 (D + 1)^2 + 1) in place of 50000; (5) for any separator tree with constants alpha and beta, the filled graph of elimination in its nested dissection order has at most alpha (alpha + beta) n (1 + log_{3/2} n) edges; (6), (7) for every plane graph, and for the square of every plane graph of maximum degree at most D, there are a separator tree covering all vertices and the permutation listing its nested dissection order such that the filled graph of that order has at most 2 T^2 n (1 + log_{3/2} n) edges (T as in (3) and (4)), and, for every matrix over a field whose off-diagonal nonzero entries are edges of the graph, permuted into that order, elimination restricted to the filled graph computes exactly the matrix after the n in-place elimination steps M_ij - M_ik M_kk^(-1) M_kj, with at most 48 T^3 n^(3/2) ring operations counted in a writer monad that charges every addition, subtraction, negation, multiplication and inversion of the explicit algorithm; the inverse is Lean's totalized field inverse (0^(-1) = 0), so these steps are Gaussian elimination without pivoting when the pivots are nonzero and leave the matrix unchanged at a zero pivot; (8) one fixed program for an explicit word RAM (unit cost per instruction, natural registers and memory cells bounded by W along the run) prints, for a plane graph with n vertices, m darts and natural vertex weights, a separator of at most 6 sqrt(n) + 3 vertices whose two parts each weigh at most 2/3 of the total, within 320m + 191n + 403 steps for word bounds at least 16m + 12n + 3 (total weight) + 22. The proofs use only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
